profile_headline: Lead Architect - Data & AI | Author | Speaker | All views are my own
post_content:
Choose your resources wisely even if it's free. As we see that LinkedIn
members are sharing free resources (pdfs, links etc) everyday. Even if it's
free, you have to pay a price in terms of your time. Before choosing a book or
course, you need to weigh & make sure if it is worth your time. You need to
ensure the quality of the material as well. It's also not that useful if you
know 80% of the stuff already. Keep limited but high quality resources to
refer, otherwise you will be distracted and most likely will waste your time.
Don't fall for free, your time is much more important. PS: And yes, as a
newbie can't weigh quality of resources on his own, having a mentor is
important. hashtag#ArtificialIntelligence hashtag#MachineLearning
hashtag#DataScience hashtag#DSAIwithAR hashtag#DataDeft
